entry.title: Let them know before a pickup
entry.invitation: When a pickup can wait, let them know and pause for their response.
entry.summary: When a pickup can wait, come into view, say what you have in mind, and pause for a response. Necessary care or protection still calls for gentle action.
entry.cue: You are about to pick your baby up, and there is time to make it an exchange.
detail: Come where your baby can see you and let them know you would like to pick them up. Wait and notice their expression or movement. If they turn away and the pickup can wait, give them more time.
Their response is something to listen to, not a certain yes-or-no signal. When care, comfort or protection is needed, the authors describe telling the baby what is happening and acting gently.
